name: Revit API Lookup (offline documentation)
description: Look up Revit API types, members and signatures in the documentation XML that ships with Revit (RevitAPI.xml, RevitAPIUI.xml), without Revit running. Read-only, no network.
author: AEC Model Bridge

commands.title: Look Up a Revit API Type, Member or Signature

query.description: What to look up: a type (Wall, Autodesk.Revit.DB.Wall), a member (GetDependentElements), a type and member (FamilyInstance.GetSubComponentIds), or a namespace (Autodesk.Revit.DB.Structure).

mode.description: auto (default) picks from the query. type: members of one class or enum, with summaries and enum values. member: is this name real, on which types; not found gives the nearest real names. signature: every overload with parameter types and names. namespace: types in a namespace.

limit.description: Most result lines to return (default 20, at most 200). truncated=true says more exist.

revit_year.description: Use the docs of this Revit version only. Default: the newest installed Revit, else the newest NuGet package.

doc_xml_path.description: Optional path to a RevitAPI.xml (or RevitAPIUI.xml) to read instead. Must be inside the workspace; other paths are refused.
